before: A VML text box on an oval, a preset template, a turned shape, a vertical story, or a shape with unknown path flags has no projection, and supported boxes paint as plain rectangles.
after: These text boxes project their story with the shape's text area, outline geometry, turn, text flow, dash pattern, shadow, and fitted size. Turned and vertical stories refuse editing; source XML is unchanged.
reason: Only drawing projection, layout, and paint change. Shared nodes, text offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged.
